intake.visible_note: The customer agreed to receive renewal information by simulated phone. The quote is still under review and must be rechecked within 24 hours. The review completion time is unknown.

contact_policy.consent_scope: Customer must explicitly accept the current quote revision before the agent submits a renewal.

customer_visible: Renewal confirmation status shown in the customer portal
visits.utterance: My coverage is about to expire and I want to confirm where the renewal stands.

intake: Verify current policy and pending quote from the insurance system.
poll: On the scheduled follow-up, read E1's current ready quote before opening simulated voice contact.
push: On E1 at 08:30, retain the pending 09:00 follow-up; defer voice contact until that wake.
outreach: Verify opt-in and the current quote; start one voice contact at 09:00.
Verify identity, explain Q2 terms and capture the customer's explicit acceptance of Q2.
Submit renewal for Q2, re-read the authoritative policy, and communicate verified confirmation in the same call.
Record Q2 delivery, accepted revision and confirmed state in the ticket and close it.
conditional_revisit: Reuse the original ticket and verify policy and quote state.
If confirmation is still missing, explain the current quote and obtain explicit acceptance before submitting.

evidence: authoritative ready quote read after E1
current quote delivered in an answered voice contact by D2 10:00
attempts counted across the previous 24 hours
version-scoped consent record precedes each submit_renewal attempt
authoritative confirmation precedes delivery of the renewal confirmation

negative_examples.action: Try to call at 08:45 before the contact window opens, then recover on inbound chat.
Try to submit the current quote before the customer has accepted it and recover after the tool rejects the attempt.
Complete and verify the renewal but omit confirmation on both the voice contact and the conditional revisit.
